verify.description: Run the COH-PMS syntax sweep and all six regression suites.
verify.template: Verify the COH-PMS project in place without editing files. Run `php tests/run_all.php`. If `php` is not on PATH, use the Laragon binary documented in Agents.md. Report the exact lint count, suite results and exit status, then stop. If a gate fails, diagnose it but do not change code unless I ask.
